name: Welcome
description: Sent once the account is confirmed, to orient a new user, state what they now have, and point at one first action.

origin.note: Design: banded welcome — split opening, capability row, ordered first run, account facts, human close.

subject: Welcome to {{ product.name }}
preheader: Your account is ready. Here is the one thing worth doing first.

credits.author: Olly
credits.title: Cheerful diverse colleagues working on a laptop during a startup project

heading_text.description: The headline, set at 34px across two lines. Write it to break well.

body.description: The paragraph under the headline. Say what the first action gets them, not that they should take it.
body.default: Connect a sending domain and you can have a real message out the door in the next few minutes.

hero_image.description: Image for the opening split. A screenshot of the product beats a photograph; use a photograph only when you have nothing real to show, and never use decoration that says nothing.

action_url.description: The one action this email is for. Stated once, not repeated in every band.

capabilities_heading.default: What your account can do now

capabilities.description: Two or three capabilities as `heading` / `text` pairs, shown side by side. Concrete abilities, not adjectives, and no icons — platform emoji render differently everywhere and read as juvenile.

steps_heading.description: Heading for the ordered first-run list.
steps_heading.default: A sensible order to do things in

steps.description: First actions worth taking, in order, as `text` / optional `detail`. Three or fewer; a longer list reads as homework.

account_rows.description: The facts a new user comes back to this email for: which address they signed up with, which plan, when a trial ends.

help_text.description: The closing offer. A named person outperforms a help-centre link, which is why this is a sentence rather than a button.
help_text.default: Reply to this email and it reaches the team that built this, not a ticket queue. We read everything.

help_url.description: Optional documentation link for people who would rather not write to anyone.
